scope: Only listed unordered geometry pairs may meet. Every pair is still measured after each step; negative distance below 1e-7 m fails. Other pairs retain positive recipe clearance. No scientific contact or continuous-time safety qualification.

shrimp_rg.rationale: Carrier deck on its linear guide; rotary sleeve and thrust-flange faces meet the retained stage disc. Ideal joint support, not a load-bearing contact calibration.

pl_service.rationale: Coaxial coupon-index disc meets its fixed cylindrical pedestal face.

electrochemical_test.rationale: The retained drawer and its perimeter clamp meet the fixture guide/seat faces at the closed inspection pose.

ultrafast_alignment.rationale: The optical translation carriage rests at its linear stage guide face.

probe_rig.rationale: The probe traverse bridge sits on the paired rail top faces.

surface_holder.rationale: The rotary sample holder meets the coaxial support disc face.

gcf_model_testbed.rationale: Nested bridge/carriage faces and probe-bearing collar end faces meet at the authored ideal joint interfaces.

moke_probe_workspace.rationale: Nested orthogonal positioning-stage decks meet at their linear guide interface.

spectrometer.rationale: Closed service cover meets its side supports; lift platform meets the coaxial sleeve end face.

wind_tunnel.rationale: The yaw disc rests on the fixed coaxial support pedestal face. The separate pitch shaft uses positive radial clearance.

cryostat_bay.rationale: The external inspection carriage rests on its supporting linear slide deck.

ma8_alignment_workspace.rationale: The nested X carriage meets its supporting deck; the theta disc meets its coaxial Y-stage support face.

tandem_rotors.rationale: The two retained inert rotor hubs meet their respective pedestal and overhead shaft end faces.

offshore_towing_rig.rationale: The transverse model trolley meets the undersides of the two moving carriage rails.

impedance_station.rationale: The retained coupon carriage meets the linear guide deck face.

model_station.rationale: The circular model turntable meets its fixed supporting disc face.

nmr_cryostat.rationale: The repaired flat lift-shaft end meets the coaxial rotating holder underside; the rounded penetrating end has been removed.

lswt_model.rationale: The model yaw disc meets the end of the vertically translating sting support.
